standard_prerequisites.use: Represents F_d over affine opens by the open U_d of Proj of the sections.

standard_prerequisites.name: Glueing of sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Glues the invertible sheaves L_i and the algebra maps psi_i over overlaps.

core_obligations: Sheaf property: glue the morphisms f_i to f, glue the L_i via the unique isomorphisms beta_{ij} forced by surjectivity of the psi_d, and glue the psi_i.
Chart representability: F_{d,i} is identified with the base-changed functor over the affine U_i, represented by the affine case.
F_{d,i} is contained in F_d representably by open immersions: a pullback lands in the chart iff its image lies in the preimage of U_i.
The charts cover F_d since the U_i cover S.
proof_roadmap: Glue quadruple data over overlaps using uniqueness of the transition isomorphisms, identify charts with the affine functor via base change, then verify the last two steps definitionally.
difficulty_reason: Four-step glue-functors verification: sheaf property by glueing quadruples with surjectivity-forced uniqueness of the transition isomorphisms, affine charts via the affine-base identification, open-immersion and covering checks; fully displayed.
